text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug in this channel. You said both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan.

While the kiosks were down, the guard wrote trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo said six trucks were waiting at the east gate at 10:44.

Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You posted that both lanes were working as of 11:07, so the outage ran about 25 minutes by your own reports.

The clock times above are the timestamps on the channel messages.
